scenario.name: Unprotected left turn across oncoming traffic
scenario.description: Left turn on a permissive green or at an uncontrolled junction, with an oncoming lane hidden by a turning vehicle, or a motorcycle approaching fast

events.description: Turns left in front of an oncoming vehicle

triggers.condition: Unprotected left turn with a turning vehicle hiding an oncoming lane
Motorcycles, and vehicles accelerating hard, approaching from far away

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way
